identity.name: Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct
identity.summary: The Llama 3.1 instruction-tuned text-only models are optimized for multilingual dialogue and outperform many open and closed chat models on common industry benchmarks.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: instruction-tuned multilingual chat model optimized for dialogue, with no reported factuality/grounding evaluation in the card, so it plausibly generates factually inaccurate content in open-ended chat.

possible_risks.description: AI, and large generative models in particular, might produce increased carbon emissions and increase water usage for their training and operation.
possible_risks.justification: 70B-parameter model trained on a new mix of publicly available online data; large-scale training and operation plausibly increase carbon emissions and water usage.

possible_risks.description: Confidential information might be included as a part of the prompt that is sent to the model.
possible_risks.justification: gated text-input chat model deployed for dialogue may receive user prompts containing confidential information, and the card reports no data-handling or privacy safeguards.

possible_risks.description: Copyrighted information or other intellectual property might be included as a part of the prompt that is sent to the model.
possible_risks.justification: trained on publicly available online data and offered as a text-input chat model, so users may include copyrighted or IP-protected material in prompts, with no stated filtering.

possible_risks.description: Applicable laws can establish data subject rights such as opt-out rights, right to access, and right to be forgotten. Synthetic data might raise unique concerns, such as the potential for reidentification of individuals from seemingly anonymous synthetic data. Data subject rights might also be relevant in scenarios where synthetic data is derived from sensitive or personal information.
possible_risks.justification: trained on a mix of publicly available online data with gated access; the card does not describe opt-out, access, or erasure mechanisms for individuals whose data may appear.

specifications.model_size: 131.4 GiB of safetensors weights (141,107,497,872 bytes) in BF16

training_context.training_data: The checkpoint was trained on a new mix of publicly available online data.
